info.title: T3 Code Relay API
info.description: Control-plane API for linking T3 environments, connecting authorized clients, and publishing agent activity.

post.summary: Register or update a mobile device
Register a Live Activity push token

get.summary: Read the current Live Activity aggregate

schema.description: Links an authenticated cloud user to a T3 environment.

notificationsEnabled.description: Whether this link may deliver push notifications.

liveActivitiesEnabled.description: Whether this link may update Live Activities.

managedTunnelsEnabled.description: Whether the relay should provision a managed tunnel for this environment.

schema.description: Requested capabilities for a new environment-link challenge.

delete.description: Deletes the provisioned Cloudflare tunnel while keeping the environment link and its hostname reservation, so a later link re-provisions the tunnel under the same URL. Environments call this when they shut down; Cloudflare bills per provisioned tunnel, so idle tunnels should not outlive their environment.

post.description: Bootstrap endpoint. Send the DPoP proof JWT in the dpop header and the Clerk token in subject_token. The returned access token is bound to the proof key.
post.summary: Exchange a Clerk token for a DPoP access token

schema.description: OAuth token exchange request for a DPoP-bound relay access token.
Requests a short-lived credential for connecting to an environment.

post.summary: Register managed tunnel recovery without provisioning

state.description: Current agent-awareness state, or null to remove the published state.

schema.description: Publishes a signed agent-awareness update from an environment.

post.summary: Deliver webhook requests held while the environment was offline now

relayDpop.description: DPoP-bound access token. Requests must also include the DPoP proof JWT header.

clientBearer.description: Clerk session or OAuth bearer token for the signed-in T3 Connect user.

environmentBearer.description: Relay-issued environment credential installed when the environment is linked.
